g.text: Versioning and promotion: build once, promote the same digest
One image is built. Its digest moves dev -> qa -> prod by editing environments/<env>/<app>.yaml. Real values from this repo (orders-api).
- dev gets sha-<commit> builds, qa/prod only x.y.z releases
- a release tag is pushed once, never moved
- promote copies tag + digest: nothing is rebuilt
- promote checks the digest still matches the registry
written by CI on every merge (deploy-dev)
written by the qa PR when a release is merged
written by Promote to production (approval + PR)
# app repo ci.yaml -> deploy-dev (deploy key), after every merge
# merge the release PR -> tag orders-api-v0.2.0
# CI: 0.2.0 not in GHCR yet -> tag this build 0.2.0
branch promote/qa-* -> PR: chore(qa): promote orders-api:0.2.0
tag=$(field tag qa); digest=$(field digest qa); source="qa"
[[ "$tag" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "::error::'$tag' is not a release version (x.y.z)"; exit 1; }
# The image must exist. Take the digest from the registry if we do not have it yet.
|| { echo "::error::$image:$tag not found in the registry"; exit 1; }
[ "$digest" = "$registry_digest" ] || { echo "::error::digest mismatch for $tag - the tag was overwritten?"; exit 1; }
merge = deploy prod | rollback = same workflow, older version
# Actions -> Promote to production -> app: orders-api, version: 0.1.0
plan: prod 0.2.0 -> 0.1.0 (rollback) image + digest verified in GHCR
production: waiting for approval ... approved by @rosaliei
PR: chore(prod): rollback orders-api 0.2.0 -> 0.1.0 -> merge -> ArgoCD syncs demo-prod
# or by hand: git revert <the commit that changed environments/prod/orders-api.yaml>
